messages.content: amar mone hoy ami nijeke onno der theke kom valo mone kori always
Eta shune sotti mon kharap lagche. Kokhon theke eta feel korcho nijer modhhe?
chotobela theke mone hoy, family te always compare hote hote
Childhood comparison genuinely leaves deep marks, eta tomar fault na. Ekhon adult hishebe, ei voice ta chinte para shuru kora important - eta tomar own thought na, eta ekta learned pattern.

Slow process eta, but shuru hoy notice kora diye - jokhon nijeke onno der sathe compare korcho, pause koro ar jigges koro nijeke "eta fair comparison naki just old habit". Time lagbe, but awareness e first step.
